name: Juniper Hill Holiday Park
accommodation: 101 serviced touring caravan/motorhome pitches with 16 amp hook-up, 10 tent pitches
beachAccess: No beach distance stated; Port Path walk to Portstewart and Portrush starts outside the park
confirmedFeatures: Electric hook-up, grey and fresh water points, bus stop outside
overview: A large council-run park at Ballyreagh Road on the A2 between Portstewart and Portrush. It has 101 serviced touring pitches with electric hook-up, bookable online, and ten tent pitches booked through the office. The Port Path coastal walk and a regular bus to both towns start just outside, and Ballyreagh Golf Course is within 200 metres.
surfTripFit: Sits between Portstewart Strand and the Portrush beaches, so a van can check several spots within minutes.
